context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 25 found that while most pages have been migrated to light theme via class replacements (bg-white, text-slate-900, border-slate-200), the CSS variables in index.css :root are still set to dark theme values. This affects components using card-surface, bg-card, bg-background classes. The Settings page is the most visibly affected. JobFormPage correctly implements recurring jobs with checkbox and frequency selector. Invoice delete is available via three-dot menu dropdown. Worker isolation and role-aware navigation working correctly.

root_cause_analysis.issue: Settings page and some components still show dark theme
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: CSS variables in /app/frontend/src/index.css :root are still set to dark theme values. The batch sed replacements changed class names but did not update the CSS custom properties.
root_cause_analysis.fix: Update CSS variables to light theme values: --background: 0 0% 100%, --card: 0 0% 100%, --secondary: 210 40% 96%, etc.
